# rag-redteam

> Open-source Python CLI that red-teams retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) chat APIs for prompt injection, system-prompt override, and OWASP LLM Top 10 retrieval attacks.

rag-redteam generates malicious .txt and .md corpus files, POSTs "Summarize the documents" to a local RAG endpoint, and fails the scan if canary strings such as EXPLOITED, SYSOVERRIDE, INDIRECTPWN, or JAILBROKEN appear in the JSON response.

## Use

- Install: clone https://github.com/saheb26/rag-redteam and run `pip install -e .`
- Command: `rag-redteam --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8000/chat --target-dir ./payloads`
- Request body: `{"query": "Summarize the documents"}`
- Response keys parsed: answer, response, message, content, text, output, result

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/saheb26/rag-redteam/blob/main/README.md): install, usage, payload catalog, API contract

## Keywords

RAG security, prompt injection scanner, indirect prompt injection, LLM red team, OWASP LLM01, vector database poisoning, LangChain security, LlamaIndex security, jailbreak detection, system prompt override
